meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 它会把 Matrix 适配器复制并注册到项目里，安装依赖、修补导入，再构建和测试，然后引导你配置独立机器人账号，从而让 Matrix 房间和私聊接入 Claude。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 Matrix 渠道接入 Claude，或在 /setup 流程中需要添加渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Matrix 渠道。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加适配器的步骤。

say.text: 用用户名和密码配置 Matrix 机器人。
say.note: Claude 会引导你输入用户名、密码和用户 ID。

say.text: 改用访问令牌来设置 Matrix。
say.note: Claude 会切换到令牌方式并提示输入令牌。

howto.what_en: It copies and registers the Matrix adapter into the project, installs the dependency, patches ESM imports, builds and tests, then guides you to set up a dedicated bot account so Matrix rooms/DMs are wired in.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or configure a Matrix channel (e.g., 'integrate Matrix' or 'set up a bot account'), or during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Help me add a Matrix channel.
say_en.note: Claude will start the adapter-setup steps.

say_en.text: Set up a Matrix bot with username and password.
say_en.note: Claude will prompt for username, password, and user ID.

say_en.text: Switch to using an access token for Matrix.
say_en.note: Claude will switch to the token flow and ask for the token.
